# freshdesk_business_hours_list (Data Source)

Every business-hours calendar on the helpdesk. Calendars are managed in the admin console rather than through the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_business_hours_list" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `business_hours` (Attributes List) Every business hours calendar the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--business_hours))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source. Always `business_hours`.

<a id="nestedatt--business_hours"></a>
### Nested Schema for `business_hours`

Read-Only:

- `business_hours` (Map of String) Working window per weekday, as a `start_time`/`end_time` JSON object.
- `created_at` (String) When the calendar was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the calendar.
- `holidays` (Map of String) Holiday dates keyed by name.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the business hours calendar.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the account's default calendar.
- `name` (String) Name of the calendar.
- `time_zone` (String) Time zone the calendar is expressed in.
- `updated_at` (String) When the calendar was last changed (RFC 3339).
